verdict.rationale: Polar's own docs show finance users can start a payout (withdrawal) on demand once their balance meets a minimum threshold, and can view the available payout balance on the Finance page. That gives some control over payout timing, but only as one-off manual withdrawals; nothing shows a configurable recurring payout schedule. Nothing shows a per-payout breakdown of the charges, fees, and refunds that make up each payout. Missing for 10: configurable recurring payout schedule, per-payout itemized composition (charges, fees, refunds), reconciliation exports or reports, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can control the payout schedule and see exactly which charges, fees, and refunds make up each payout

citations.quote: You can issue a withdrawal — also called a payout — once your balance meets the minimum threshold for your account currency.
You can see your available balance for payout at any time under your Finance page.
